summary: A wizard wishes for a boulder while standing in a pit, and the boulder lands on the trapped hero. do.c:flooreffects calls losehp with NO_KILLER_PREFIX; js/do.js has the same branch but does not import that constant, so the replay stops before the case reaches its boulder resolution.

source.branch: When a boulder lands on a pit or hole containing the trapped hero, and the hero neither passes walls nor throws rocks, do.c:flooreffects calls losehp(Maybe_Half_Phys(rnd(15)), "squished under a boulder", NO_KILLER_PREFIX), then removes the trap and boulder. js/do.js:flooreffects has the matching branch and call but omits NO_KILLER_PREFIX from its const.js imports.
callers: C wizcmds.c:wiz_wish -> zap.c:makewish -> invent.c:hold_another_object -> invent.c:dropx/dropy/dropz -> do.c:flooreffects. JS wizcmds.js:wiz_wish -> zap.js:makewish -> invent.js:hold_another_object/gotoDrop -> invent.js:dropx -> do.js:flooreffects.

evidence: The admitted v71 evaluation records zero of 306 screens and the stop ReferenceError: NO_KILLER_PREFIX is not defined.
A focused scan of the admitted recording reproduces the error at js/do.js:1065; the call stack is flooreffects -> dropzAdmitted -> dropx -> gotoDrop -> hold_another_object -> makewish -> wiz_wish.
Upstream do.c:flooreffects (161-357) passes NO_KILLER_PREFIX to losehp in the trapped-hero boulder branch. js/const.js exports the same constant; js/do.js references it without importing it.
The recorded recipe places the Healer in a pit and wishes for a boulder. The boulder lands on the trapped hero and reaches the source branch during hold_another_object drop handling.
